spec.description: JAOPS spacecraft demonstrator: mission telemetry, Canvas, aggregate and array data, payload imagery, simulator commanding, alarm/link operations and plugin diagnostics. Software simulation, not flight-qualified control.

Transmission constraints

options.content: Transmission constraintsPayload must be on. Otherwise Yamcs rejects this command after 5 s; expand its history row for the reason.

spec.description: Mission database

options.content: Mission databaseFour concrete commands share two abstract packet definitions. This view demonstrates dual battery buttons and typed payload arguments. The full MDB, packet definitions and command browser remain available in Yamcs.

spec.title: Bus voltage / load correlation
spec.description: Native XY chart of generated bus voltage and current, joined by sample timestamp.
Commanding the simulator

options.content: Commanding the simulatorSelect a battery or payload mode, then issue a command. Yamcs validates and encodes its arguments. History shows dispatch, not spacecraft execution: this fixture receives commands but replays telemetry independently.

spec.description: One datasource, two clocks

options.content: One datasource, two clocksTime sync follows Yamcs mission time. The archive and live stream share one dashboard range. Panel overrides can retain a longer command history.

spec.description: From telemetry to decisions

options.content: From telemetry to decisionsHistogram: sample distribution. XY: bus voltage and load current at matching times. Explore opens the same datasource for ad-hoc queries. Native inspectors expose values and transformations.

spec.description: Plugin observability

options.content: Plugin observabilityDemand rows describe Grafana streams. Subscription rows describe Yamcs parameters. Several views can share the same underlying parameter subscription.
